newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran wins land reclamation job - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ekran wins land reclamation job - paper.

text.p: Infrastructure developer and property group Ekran Bhd has won an eight billion ringgit job to reclaim 3,000 hectares of land in northern Kedah state, The Star newspaper reported on Friday.
It quoted Ekran's executive chairman Ting Pek Khiing as saying the company plans to build a township on the reclaimed land in the Kuala Kedah region.
A jetty and transit point for tourists to visit nearby popular Langkawi resort island will also be built.
Ting told reporters at his office in Sarawak on Thursday that the project has been approved by the state government and will take 10 years to complete.
Ekran officials were not immediately available for comment.
